section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews the role of gender in loneliness and gratitude, drawing on various previous studies. It discusses gender differences in emotion regulation, social networks, and the experience and expression of gratitude. Specifically, it highlights a study by Kashdan et al. (2009) that examined young (n=214, Mage=20.5 years, 72.4% women) and older adults (n=77, Mage=69.6 years, 61.8% women) regarding their experience of receiving gifts.
